Name: Gremory
Front Side: If you control 4 tokens: Deal +2 damage during combat
Ultimate Side: You Basic Emblem is still active and usable. Instead of only applying to Tier I units, now all Tier Units can be replaced by Rose Units. Each Rose Unit in the Exhaust Zone adds to the total damage when damage is dealt to the enemy goalie. After a goal remove all Rose Units and return the previous Units that were traded in.

Name: Zepar
Ultimate Side: You Basic Emblem is still active and usable. When a Swan Unit attacks an enemy Unit, transform it into a Swan Unit as well, it loses all other creature types during combat. Give the enemy unit -2 Power during combat.

Name: Sallos
Front Side: Always counts as defending. Deal 1 damage to the enemy goalie
Ultimate Side: You Basic Emblem is still active and usable. When an enemy Unit that has been marked by a song, if they have two song counters: they lose 1 power during combat. If they have three song counters: Deal 3 damage to the enemy goalie. Then it loses all counters.

Name: Belphegor
Front Side: If this has a burn counter + shooting at goal: Deal +2 damage to goalie
Ultimate Side:
Rauhnacht-Feuergeister get +1 Attack Power during combat for each victory counter. 
After a goal, lose all counters and activate Belphegor's Emblem again

Name: Flauros
Front Side: Reveal a unit from your exhaust zone. Give this unit +1 damage during combat if the revealed card was fire
Ultimate Side:
Create a permanent weapon token for one Star Unit. The weapons attack is the strongest fused unit.  
Break up all fused units and send them to the exhaust zone.

Name: Buer
Front Side: This unit has attack equal to the victory counters you have. Remove 1 victory counter.
Ultimate Side:
Give the permanent Teufel Mask counter on a unit in the field zone and change its unit type to basic. 
When the unit is in combat, it obtains the Rauhnacht-Feuergeister unit type, and +1 Attack Power each counter on the Teufel Mask. 
After each combat give the unit with Teufel Mask - 1 Attack Power during combat. 
After the unit deals - 1 Attack Power during combat remove the Teufel Mask and return its unit type.

Name: Belial
Front Side: Consume 1 ore counter: Give another unit a temporary weapon that gives +1 power during combat.
Ultimate Side: For each Player mining during play, gain 1 bonus ore counter. Each Bergmännlein now has access to the ore shop during combat. Accessing the ore shop, counts as the ability trigger, and won't trigger the attack or defend abilites if used.

Name: Valefor
Front Side: Consume 1 ore counter: Gain 3 ore counters
Ultimate Side: Bergmännlein in the exhaust zone mine ore counters. Each Bergmännlein that was mining the round before is giving +1 power during their next combat.

Name: Haures
Front Side: Consume 1 ore counter: Give your goalie +1 stamina
Ultimate Side: Your goalie is now able to consume ore counters as well. Each ore counter adds armor to the goalie, which gives the goalie a shield and decreases the % change of a goal. Your goalie can only consume 3 ore per cycle.

Name: Vassago
Front Side: This unit power is equal to each Tier II enemy in the exhaust zone
Ultimate Side: All of your Unkengeister have now the ability to choose an enemy ability in their exhaust zone that fits to their Tier level and use it as their own during combat. Any enemy unit's ability being copied cannot escape the exhaust zone until the cycle ends.

Name: Glasya-Labolas
Front Side: This unit power is equal to each unique structure, element or object on the field (max 3)
Ultimate Side: Your Unkengeister can now possess any structure, element or object that has been added to the field. When the enemy interacts with the possessed objects, they are terrified and don't gain the benefits of that interaction one time. Cannot possess the same object multiple times in one cycle.

Name: Caim
Front Side: The next two Unkengeister units get +1 power during combat
Ultimate Side: Spawn gravestones onto the soccer field, when the soccer ball knocks them over, spawn a ghost attaching it to the ball. The next Unkengeister gets +1 power for each ghost counter on the ball. After combat remove all ghost counters from the ball.
